purpose: Teach: 椎/蕾/唾/皺/両端/左折/８つ/スギ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが椎茸の収穫を手伝って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father said he'd help you harvest the shiitake mushrooms.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. A small smile in the voice. Sharing something she knows will please him. No fuss, just the simple fact of a kind thing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと桜の蕾を観に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to look at the cherry blossoms with Dad.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the memory. Speaking to share something good, not to boast. A small, genuine smile underneath. Soft, present tone.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「唾を飛ばさない様に話せ」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father mentioned you should be careful not to spray saliva when you talk.
lines.style: Gently wry, almost amused at the specificity. Delivered with affection — this is the kind of thing fathers notice and say. Tender underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「服の皺を伸ばしてね」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me to iron out the wrinkles in my clothes.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact pride. Speaking as if reporting something important he'd learned. Earnest, attentive — the weight of something a grown-up taught him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが本棚の両端を補強して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father reinforced both ends of the bookshelf for you.
lines.style: Simple, warm recognition of care. No drama — just the quiet acknowledgement of something practical and thoughtful he did. Steady affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「次の交差点を左折」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me which way to turn at the next intersection.
lines.style: Attentive and earnest. Reporting something learned with the seriousness of real instruction. Small, steady voice — not bragging, just remembering.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお団子を８つ買って来て下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father brought home eight dango for us.
lines.style: Warm, pleased surprise. A light touch on the number — noticing he counted them. Small, genuine smile. The voice of someone sharing something sweet.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんがスギ花粉に苦しんでらっしゃるよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's been really struggling with cedar pollen.
lines.style: Quiet concern underneath. Speaking softly, as if noticing something he hasn't complained about. The earnest attention of someone who watches and cares. Slight trailing-off, like he's thinking about it.
